description: Writes a webinar run of show and a full spoken script from your topic, target audience and webinar type. Optional duration, key takeaways, speakers, polls, product mention level, your product and business model shape it. Returns the run of show, the script with the speaker lines and on-screen cues for each segment built from your takeaways and speakers, polls with answer options, anticipated questions with answers, a follow-up email sequence and sector notes. Without key takeaways it suggests them from the topic and type. The script uses only what you gave and says what it did not get.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge, so the advice fits it. If omitted, it is read from your text and the answer says how.

include_polls.description: Include poll suggestions with answer options

key_takeaways.description: Optional: what attendees should learn, one per line, per semicolon or comma-separated. If not provided, takeaways are suggested from the topic

product_mention_level.description: Whether to add product tie-in placeholders to the script ('none' leaves them out)

speakers.description: Optional: speakers as you want them listed. Separate speakers with semicolons or line breaks ('Name, Title; Name, Title'), or with commas if each is one phrase

target_audience.description: Who will attend (for example 'Support leaders at consumer apps')

webinar_type.description: The kind of webinar; sets the structure

your_product.description: Optional: your product or service name, used in the answer. Without it the answer says so and shows a placeholder.

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: webinar_script
title: Webinar Script
